llm.summary: The skill's code, instructions, and required environment variable align with its stated purpose (uploading a single local file to Duhui's async conversion service and returning a PDF), but it deliberately uploads user files to vendor-controlled OSS — users must consent to that data flow and protect the AppCode secret outside chat.

dimensions.detail: Name/description, SKILL.md, and the included Python script consistently implement Duhui's async doc->PDF flow: fetch temporary OSS upload credentials from the vendor, upload the local file to the vendor's temporary OSS bucket, call doc2pdf v2/convert_async with Authorization: APPCODE, poll the vendor query endpoint, download the PDF, and attempt best-effort cleanup. The single declared env var (DUHUI_ALI_APPCODE) is expected for calling the market API.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md and script explicitly instruct uploading the user's local file to a vendor-controlled OSS bucket and fetching temporary upload credentials from https://file.duhuitech.com/k/tmp_up.json. This is within the declared purpose but is a privacy-sensitive network behavior that must be disclosed to and accepted by the user (the SKILL.md contains a required user notice). The instructions do not attempt to read unrelated system secrets or files.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec; the skill is instruction-plus-script and requires only python3 (no external package installs). Nothing in the install surface downloads or executes untrusted code at install time.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests a single environment variable (DUHUI_ALI_APPCODE) which is proportional to calling the Aliyun Market API. The script also fetches temporary OSS credentials at runtime from a vendor endpoint (not an environment secret) — this is necessary for the chosen upload workflow but increases exposure of uploaded content to the vendor's infrastructure. The SKILL.md explicitly forbids collecting the AppCode via chat and requires use of secure secret injection.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request elevated or permanent platform privileges. It does cache fetched OSS credentials only in-process (per SKILL.md/script) and does not modify other skills or system-wide agent settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill does what it says: it uploads a single local file to the vendor's temporary OSS bucket, calls Duhui's async convert API using an AppCode you must provide via your agent's secure secret mechanism (do not paste it into chat), and returns a PDF. Before installing or running: 1) Confirm you are OK with your file being uploaded to fmtmp.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com and vendor endpoints (file.duhuitech.com, api.duhuitech.com); 2) Supply DUHUI_ALI_APPCODE through a secure, non-chat secret store or environment injection; 3) If documents may contain sensitive data, consider local conversion alternatives (LibreOffice, enterprise converters) instead of uploading; 4) Review the included script if you want assurance there are no other endpoints or behaviors — the script does fetch temporary credentials from a vendor URL and uses them to sign OSS uploads (this is expected for the described workflow).
